prompt.generated_prompt_string: A fit adult Asian woman frozen in mid-air while running, capturing a dynamic athletic moment. Focused eyes looking ahead, determined expression, natural fresh makeup, black high ponytail flying back dynamically due to motion. Athletic toned body with covered chest and visible muscular leg definition during a mid-air running stride, one knee raised high and arms swinging. She wears a pastel pink long-sleeve athletic zip-up jacket with fitted sporty seams and matching pastel pink athletic shorts, plus white sneakers with black swoosh logo and white crew socks. Commercial advertising photography, low-angle worm's-eye view, full-body side profile, 3:4 aspect ratio, sharp focus, high contrast, commercial print quality, hard direct daylight and strong shadows, deep background visible with geometric architecture. Urban modern exterior with blue-gray glass wall, geometric triangular glass facade, metallic frames, runner reflection in glass and brick pavement at bottom. Massive bold white sans-serif text JUST DO IT is centered behind the subject or layered over the center with slight transparency. Atmosphere is modern, clean, energetic and motivational, with explosive power and a morning city run story. Keep text clearly visible, mid-air suspension, pastel pink outfit, geometric glass background and sharp focus; avoid misspelled text, text covering the face, blur, studio background and static pose.
